root_cause: The coordinator looks the switch up by a built name switch.<room_slug>_automation, but HA created it as switch.<slug>_<slug>_automation (device name + entity name). The lookup returns None and _is_automation_enabled defaults to True (fail open), so the OFF switch is ignored.
root_cause_must_mention: built-name lookup misses the double-prefixed entity id
missing switch defaults to enabled (fails open)
correct_actions: propose_action tier=code: resolve room switches via the entity registry by unique_id (entry_id + key), fail closed or warn loudly on miss
acceptable_extra: note a temporary workaround (renaming entity ids) is an operator config action, R3
invented_evidence_traps: Claiming the switch is not actually off
Claiming another automation drives the lights
discriminator: The not-found result for the built id plus the default-True code path is the only mechanism that ignores an OFF switch.
